[NFCT.5.1] Every fact lifecycle event passes through the stream callback
(`ds_engine_set_stream_callback`; [NCBK.2]):

| Kind | Fires when | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| `DS_EV_FACT_ASSERT`  | an assert arrived ([RFCS.6.7]): a new fact entered working memory; or an upsert's replacement did, and the old fact's `DS_EV_FACT_RETRACT` follows; or a no-op reassertion left the live fact in place; or the engine refused the assert, and its `DS_EV_BOUNDS_ERROR` follows | `event->p.fact_assert.fact` |
| `DS_EV_FACT_RETRACT` | a fact left working memory (your retract, the TTL sweep, a rule-side retract, or upsert replacement) | `event->p.fact_retract.fact` |

The payload of a refused assert's `DS_EV_FACT_ASSERT` is valid only for the
callback, and is not a working-memory handle: the fact never entered.

`DS_EV_FACT_MODIFY` is reserved in the enum and **not emitted** — an upsert
surfaces as a `FACT_ASSERT` followed by a `FACT_RETRACT`, not a modify. A `switch` over
the kind still needs the case: the member is in the public enum. The full event catalogue is in [NCBK.2].
